---
title: Add User
description: >-
  Create admin profiles by entering user details, setting up credentials, and
  choosing specific permissions for system access.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1373" height="758" style="width: 1373px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Settings > User > Add User.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="290" height="174" style="width: 290px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Input the username, password, email, and system role. Additionally, ensure you key in other relevant details such as the user's name and preferred language.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="454" height="425" style="width: 454px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
